business_problem: Spark Compass wanted venues such as stadiums, airports, and entertainment sites to understand in-person customers as well as digital businesses do, but fragmented ticketing, loyalty, mobile, POS, and location systems left operators unable to personalize offers, prove sponsor impact, or react in real time.
solution_summary: Spark Compass built an open, hybrid-cloud customer-intelligence platform on IBM watsonx technologies so venues could unify physical-world signals without giving up control of their data. The platform connects more than 100 modules and sources spanning ticketing, loyalty, mobile apps, transactions, location services, and operational signals into a real-time customer view. IBM watsonx.data consolidates those fragmented inputs into a single foundation, IBM watsonx.ai predicts behavior and recommends offers or next-best actions, IBM watsonx Orchestrate triggers follow-on actions such as messaging, signage updates, or staff notifications, and IBM watsonx.governance adds oversight for customer data and automated decisions. Because the architecture is modular and API-driven, venues can keep existing systems in place while applying AI to crowd movement, concessions, engagement campaigns, and sponsor measurement. The result is a governed intelligence layer for physical environments that behaves more like a digital growth platform than a standalone app.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.data
solution_components.role: Creates the real-time single source of truth by consolidating fragmented venue and customer data.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Generates behavior predictions and personalized recommendations in the moment.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Automates the downstream actions triggered by AI recommendations, from offers to staff notifications.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.governance
solution_components.role: Provides transparency and oversight for AI models, customer data usage, and automated decisions.

data_flow: Ticketing, loyalty, mobile, transaction, and location signals stream into the Spark Compass platform, watsonx.data unifies them into a live customer profile, watsonx.ai scores behavior and recommends the next action, watsonx Orchestrate triggers outreach or operational changes, and venues use the measured results to refine future campaigns and staffing decisions.
business_outcome: Spark Compass helped venues improve engagement, attendance, and conversion while giving marketing, operations, concessions, and security teams a shared view of customers they can measure, own, and act on in real time.
metrics: 88% venue visit rate from location-based engagement campaigns
over 140M real-world behavior data points from 22,000 active users
over 15% additional in-store sponsor product sales

The architecture is open API-based and hybrid-cloud so venues retain data ownership.
Teams across marketing, operations, concessions, and security use the same customer view.
